jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/x)
jobs.description: About accilium accilium is an award-winning strategy and management consultancy shaping the future of mobility and energy. We work with industry leaders in Automotive & Transport, Energy & Environment, and Public & Infrastructure. Founded in 2017, we've grown to 110+ people across 7 offices: Berlin, Munich, Vienna, Cologne, Hamburg, Bucharest and Warsaw. Our software subsidiary &amp (50+ developers) lets us deliver end-to-end. We've been ranked Top 10 in the brand eins/Statista "Best Consultants" list five years running and were named "Hidden Champion 2026/2027". The role As Forward Deployed Engineer, you work with our clients to turn breakthroughs in AI technology and research into production systems. Working at the intersection of bleeding edge technologies and the transformation of leading enterprises' core value chains, you will drive organizational transformation and help our clients re-architect work. You'll also help build accilium itself into an AI-native company. Through Project aIQ, our internal transformation program, we ship weekly builds of "acciliumOS", the agents and tools our own consultants work with. You join the FDE team in our Technology Practice, and you'll help shape how it grows. What you'll do Build agentic systems with our clients and embed them in their core processes, from first prototype to production. Ship concrete artifacts: agents, MCP servers, agent skills and integrations used in real workflows. Turn what works into reusable patterns, for accilium and, where we can, for the open-source community. Work on-site with client teams, explain what you built, and spot the next use case. Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI development stacks. Expand accilium’s build capabilities for agentic systems and deploy solutions for our internal value chains What you bring A Master's or Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, engineering or similar.

jobs.title: Content & Growth Marketer
jobs.description: About Tradeaze Tradeaze is on-demand delivery for the built environment. Builders' merchants book a delivery in our app, and a vetted driver collects from the branch and delivers to site the same day. We work with national groups like Jewson, Travis Perkins, EH Smith and Lords, and we are growing fast. You would be the second person in growth and marketing, joining as the new brand and website go live. The role You are a content-leaning generalist marketer who uses AI to do the work of a bigger team. Your job is to bring new branches onto Tradeaze and turn them into regular customers. You make the message; we run the system behind it. What you will do Make content for two audiences: the people who use Tradeaze every day (branch staff and drivers), and the people who follow us on LinkedIn as a tech-forward start-up. Posts, short video, case studies, printed pieces, content from around the office Turn one real delivery into three things in a week: a case study, a post and a one-pager sales can carry into a branch Write the campaigns that turn a new branch into a regular customer, from the idea to the words to the design Sit with the marketing team at a merchant head office and run a joint campaign across their branches Keep socials and the blog moving, with AI doing the first draft and you deciding what's good Be out at yards and branches with a camera, and at trade events with a stand Who you are Around 3 years in marketing, in a small team or start-up where you made the work yourself. Less is fine if your work shows it You take ownership. You spot what needs doing and do it without being asked, and you treat the results as yours. You've designed things people actually used: a post, a flyer, a deck. Use whatever tool you like (Figma, Adobe), as long as the work looks professional You write for an audience, whether you write it yourself or set the lines and guidelines and have AI draft it. Either way you know what a counter manager will read and what a LinkedIn follow

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: About GlassFlow GlassFlow builds data infrastructure for AI agents in production, featuring two core products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data across systems, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs agent behavior. Operating as a Berlin startup backed by Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, and the ex-CTO of Aiven, the team comprises serial entrepreneurs with over 10 years of experience. What you will do As a Founding Engineer, you will shape the platform's technical foundation in a hybrid role based in Berlin. You will collaborate directly with the founders to build and scale the infrastructure supporting AI agents. Product Integration for Client Use Cases Go-to Person for technical questions for the internal sales and marketing team Building and developing the connector and ingestion layer Part of the core development team Creation of product tutorials and guides What the role requires This permanent position is offered at 40 hours per week with a 6-month probation period. You will work within a small, fast-paced team environment. You are: Fluent in Python Knowledge of frontend frameworks like TypeScript and React is a plus Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure) Experience with DevOps (Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions) Worked in fast-growing environments and/or early-stage startups Willing to work once a week in our Berlin office Your first months at GlassFlow You will dive straight into the core architecture, collaborating on initial feature rollouts for GlassFlow Tares and GlassFlow Rius. During your first months, you will establish foundational engineering workflows and contribute directly to the production codebase. Working environment and perks You will receive company stock options and flexible working hours to manage your schedule. The role includes public transportation benefits, home office options, and complete home office equipment alongside a company laptop and travel expenses compensation. Additional pro

jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: About 3Y Health 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry. About the role Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. What you'll do Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex Our stack Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform

jobs.title: Founding Robotics Engineer Navigation & Autonomy
jobs.description: ABOUT NAXON Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones. Why now : rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site. Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM). THE ROLE You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there. As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination WHAT YOU BRING Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos Strong in SLA

jobs.description: At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . About the role We’re looking for our first product designer to level-up design throughout the company. Axle is building cutting-edge energy products across the sector - from simple offerings for mass-market consumers, through to advanced tooling for early adopters and enthusiasts. We’re innovating to solve new and complex problems where there’s no established answers and where the customer experience is key. We have a highly autonomous, flat structure, delivering our products in small interdisciplinary teams of engineers and PMs. We want to add a design voice as a pillar to this: understanding our users, leading our strategic direction, and ensuring the customer is always represented. You’ll operate across the business to raise the quality of all our design output - through both direct delivery, as well as enablement and coaching of others. Alongside this, we’re looking for ownership and support on how Axle represents itself externally - to our prospects, clients, investors and potential employees. What you will be doing: Understanding user problems and designing great experiences to solve them Building the systems that allow for strategic and scalable solutions - in Claude and code - to allow everybody to ship beautiful software, faster Deepening our culture of user research and getting into the weeds of how people experience Axle's products, both B2C and B2B

jobs.description: About Isembard Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics. The role This role sits where MasonOS meets the shop floor. Every new factory in our network adds training, adoption and support work. Run onboarding, training and day-to-day adoption with machinists, engineers and site operators. Turn repeated support questions into playbooks, training material or self-service tools. You are measured on the support burden falling, not on tickets closed. Put agentic workflows into operational use: reporting, supplier follow-ups and order status. Ship fixes and small features into MasonOS through the same review as every other engineer. Turn patterns from the field into clear, written requirements for the roadmap. What you bring The ability to ship production code with minimal supervision. Full-stack fluency across backend, frontend and integrations. Hands-on experience applying LLMs to real workflows. Clear communication with operators and technical leaders, and the ability to build trust on site. The judgement to decide what matters without waiting for a ticket queue. Useful, not essential: forward-deployed or deployment engineering experience, exposure to manufacturing, CNC, aerospace or defence, or MES or ERP systems. jobs.title: Junior Business Data Analyst

We specialize in the international trade of raw materials/ingredients (starches, sugars and plant proteins) for the food, animal feed and paper industries and operate in more than 100 countries. The company culture is relaxed when possible and businesslike when needed. In an open office environment, we aim for short and direct communication between all departments. We are looking for new talents with a no-nonsense mentality who want to actively contribute to the further growth of the company, with own initiative encouraged. The role As a Junior Business Data Analyst, you are the link between business and IT. You bring together processes and data to support decision-making. You help the organization to use data structurally, reliably and effectively. You look beyond data alone: you make processes clear, see opportunities for digitization and automation and use data to help departments. You become part of the IT & Data team and work with all departments, including Finance, Trade and Logistics. You translate data into concrete insights and actively contribute to the further professionalization of data-driven work within Royal Ingredients. What will you do? jobs.title: Stageplaats bij Pharmapartners
jobs.description: Wil jij als meewerk- of afstudeerstagiair(e) het verschil voor de zorg maken en jezelf ontwikkelen als professional? Jij doet dat bij PharmaPartners. Hoe? Dat lees je hieronder: “Momenteel loop ik stage bij PharmaPartners. Het is mijn eerste stage en het bevalt me ontzettend goed. Ik werk bij de Customer Support afdeling van eHealth aan mijn eigen opdracht, waarmee ook echt iets gedaan wordt. Je krijgt hier veel vertrouwen en vrijheid om aan je eigen opdracht te werken en initiatief te tonen, maar er is altijd iemand die met je meedenkt. De open en informele sfeer zorgt ervoor dat je bij iedereen terecht kunt met vragen of gewoon voor een praatje, zowel binnen de afdeling als in de rest van de organisatie. Het is een fijne plek om te ontdekken wat je leuk vindt en om jezelf te ontwikkelen in een professionele, maar informele omgeving.” Kristi Imming – Stagiaire Customer Support PharmaPartners maakt software voor de eerstelijns zorg in Nederland, voor huisartsen, apotheken en patiënten. Binnen ons bedrijf hebben wij diverse afdelingen waarvoor we enthousiaste meewerk- en afstudeerstagiaires zoeken. Zoek jij een stage binnen een onze afdelingen, Research & Development, Innovatie, Sales of Support? Lees dan verder! De collega’s van PharmaPartners gaan samen met jou aan de slag om de eerstelijnszorg te verbeteren. Vind jij het als stagiaire leuk om: Met jouw frisse blik een bijdrage te leveren aan de zorg; Een stapje extra te zetten door het beste uit jezelf te halen; Samen met leuke collega’s te streven naar het beste resultaat?; Jezelf te ontwikkelen als professional en als kennishouder in jouw vakgebied?; Jezelf flexibel in te zetten en om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken? En doe je dat allemaal het liefste samen met open, eerlijke en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte, informele organisatie? Dan past een stageplaats bij een van de afdelingen binnen PharmaPartners zeker bij jou. In 2025 gingen 11 stagiaires jou voor! Ben jij de nieuwe stagiaire van 2026

jobs.description: Localisation Poste basé à Avignon (84). Vous souhaitez découvrir concrètement comment se développent les projets de stockage par batteries et contribuer à la transition énergétique ? Au sein de l’équipe Novar en France, vous serez accompagné·e par les équipes de développement et les supports techniques. Vous participerez, à votre niveau, à l’identification de sites et à la préparation des premières analyses et démarches d’autorisation pour des projets de stockage. Vous accompagnerez également dans leurs missions de développement de projets solaires les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets et les Chef.fe .s de projets. Vos missions · Identification de sites pour des projets de stockage par batteries. Pour cela, un travail d’analyse et de suivi des évolutions techniques et réglementaires devra être réalisé. · Analyses et prédimensionnement du projet de stockage sur la base des informations collectées (caractéristiques du réseau électrique à proximité ; règles d’urbanismes ; enjeux liés à l’occupation du sol, aux accès, au voisinage et aux zonages environnementaux). · Préparer des supports de synthèse (recherches documentaires, cartographie et tableaux de suivi) et apprendre à faire ressortir les principaux points à approfondir. · Accompagner les Chef.fe .s de projet en Développement et les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets dans leurs missions et se familiariser avec les démarches de sécurisation foncière, de développement de projets et de permitting sous leurs supervisions. jobs.description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager, UK
jobs.description: Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager to lead our organisation and team in the UK as Market Lead and be the public face of Change.org in the country. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through deep networks across UK politics, civil society, civic tech, newsrooms, broadcasters, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle. We'd welcome ambitious and entrepreneurial Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role. Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions. What you will achieve Create awareness spikes . Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Turn those moments into measurable growth for Change.org in the UK, such as new petition starters, signers and supporters. At a Senior Manager level, own the UK team's goals and report on how campaigns contribute to Change.org 's wider growth targets. Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Coach them on strategy, find the route to victory, and help them build the pressure that gets decision makers to act.

jobs.description: The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design. Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting. Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination. Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden. Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai , RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing. jobs.title: Customer Operations Director
jobs.description: Customer Operations Director Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence? As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets. Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery. This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations. What will you do? You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance. You will: Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels. Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries. Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets. Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation. Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up. Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs. Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals. Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product. Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high

jobs.title: Environment Artist
jobs.description: About Techtive Games Techtive Games is a Germany-based video game developer creating Ardem , an open-world survival game. Built by former modding veterans, the studio combines AA-level ambition with an independent mindset to push development practices forward and build immersive worlds built to be played, modified, and expanded. We're looking for an Environment Artist to join our team as we move into full production on our debut game Ardem, an open world survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5. In this role, your focus is asset production, with a strong emphasis on architecture and modularity. Our world artists build Ardem's world —> you create what they build it with: modular architecture kits, bespoke landmark structures, and the environmental assets that make the world feel believable and lived-in. You won't be doing level design yourself, but you need the instincts of someone who could — assets only work if they're made with world-building in mind. At Techtive, we believe in a creative workflow where everyone contributes to the final look and feel of the world. It's a team effort: you'll work closely with World Art, Tech Art, and 3D Art, using cutting-edge UE5 tech to push visuals to new heights. One thing we care about a lot: we're hiring from our community. We want people who actually play survival games — not as market research, but because it's your genre. If you know from hundreds of hours in the genre why a base location feels right, why a ruin tells a story, or why clutter placement can make or break immersion, you already understand half the job. That's also why we'd love it if you share your Steam profile with your application — not as a gate, we're just genuinely curious where your gaming interests lie and how much they overlap with what we're building. jobs.description: Wollen Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft in einem wegweisenden Projekt gestalten? Bei der Deutschen Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) in Düsseldorf erwartet Sie eine spannende Herausforderung. Sie leiten daraus Empfehlungen für die Ausgestaltung unserer Marktangebote ab und entwickeln Tools zur systematischen Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit in Deutschland. This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. Du sorgst dafür, dass Projekte im Shop wirklich fertig werden, Shopify konsequent ausgereizt wird und unsere Loyalty- und Retention-Mechaniken Bestandskundinnen häufiger und wertiger kaufen lassen. jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du willst Lieferketten nicht nur verwalten, sondern wirklich gestalten? Bei Rosental Organics übernimmst du die volle Ownership über unsere internationale Beschaffung von Verpackungsmaterialien bis zu Produktkomponenten und baust die Prozesse auf, die unser Wachstum tragen. Du stellst die permanente Verfügbarkeit aller Verpackungsmaterialien und Produktkomponenten sicher. Engpässe verhinderst du, bevor sie entstehen. Du hältst eine stabile Bestandsreichweite von 1–6 Monaten für alle relevanten Produkte und passt sie kontinuierlich an den Forecast an. Du verhandelst aktiv mit chinesischen Lieferanten und reduzierst die COGS nachhaltig durch starke Konditionen und strategische Partnerschaften. Du baust belastbare Prozesse für die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Lieferanten auf, inklusive vollständiger Compliance-Dokumentation und klarer Kommunikationswege. Du entwickelst und pflegst klare SOPs und sorgst für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit allen internen Schnittstellen. Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Verhandlung mit chinesischen Lieferanten. Du kennst die Hebel und holst das Beste für das Unternehmen heraus. Du bringst interkulturelle Kompetenz im China-Kontext mit und weißt, wie Kommunikation dort funktioniert (und nutzt das als Vorteil). Du erstellst stabile, datenbasierte Forecasts und Bestandsplanungen, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in gängigen ERP- oder Planning-Tools. Du behältst den Überblick über Bestände, Liefertermine und Produktionspläne, auch wenn viele Variablen gleichzeitig in Bewegung sind. Du denkst in Prozessen: Du erkennst, was ineffizient läuft, gestaltest bessere Abläufe und bringst andere mit auf den Weg. Du kommunizierst auf Englisch und Deutsch verhandlungssicher. Participer à la mise en production des assistants, de leur API jusqu’à leur intégration dans l’interface web interne. jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is s

jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
jobs.description: What we're building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy . Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute. The role You push the physics of Genesis-World forward.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai . Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu il veut installer, et un écosystème d éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production. À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.
